target.title: Preserve Codex output after missing turn completion
target.body:
## Summary

Supersedes the patch from #99167 because the original contributor branch cannot be pushed to by `100yenadmin` despite `maintainerCanModify=true`.

- Preserve captured assistant text only for Codex app-server `turn_completion_idle_timeout` failures from the completion-watch path.
- Fail closed when recovery could duplicate or replace side effects, terminal output, active Codex items, replay evidence, tool activity, cron writes, committed message sends, accepted session spawns, or async tool activity.
- Keep non-completion turn-watch timeouts, including progress-watch timeouts with assistant output, on the existing timeout/error path.
- Add deterministic embedded-runner regressions for safe assistant-output preservation, non-completion watchdogs, active item lifecycle, and terminal-state recovery blocking.
- Update the Codex harness docs so the recovery contract names terminal-output evidence as a recovery blocker.

## What Problem This Solves

Codex app-server can do useful work and produce assistant output but then fail to emit the terminal `turn/completed` event. OpenClaw needs a narrow mitigation for the safe completion-timeout case so the user does not lose a final answer, while still failing closed for non-completion watchdogs and side-effectful or terminal-output turns.

The prior #99167 draft allowed assistant-output recovery whenever `shouldSurfaceCodexCompletionTimeout` was true. That predicate is broader than completion-watch timeouts, so a progress-watch timeout with assistant text could be delivered as a successful reply. The first replacement patch narrowed delivery to `turnWatchTimeoutKind === "completion"` and required `itemLifecycle.activeCount === 0`. This revision also reuses `hasAttemptTerminalState(attempt)` so heartbeat responses, tool media, source replies, accepted spawns, async tools, cron writes, and committed messaging delivery evidence cannot be overwritten by recovered assistant text.

## Evidence

Refs #87744 and #88312. Related historical items: #78756, #84076, #82080, #89974, and openai/codex#22144.

Fresh local evidence from `2026-07-03` shows the target failure class separately from the later subscription/usage-limit failure:

- `2026-07-03 01:45 GMT+7`: `codex app-server turn idle timed out waiting for completion`, `failureKind=turn_completion_idle_timeout`, `turnWatchTimeoutKind=completion`, `lastActivityReason=turn:start`, `activeAppServerTurnRequests=0`, `activeTurnItemCount=0`, `terminalTurnNotificationQueued=false`.
- `2026-07-03 02:24 GMT+7`: separate `rate_limit` / subscription usage-limit failure. This PR does not address that second failure.

Red/green proof for the replacement patch and review fixes:

- RED on PR #99167 head before the code fix:
  - `OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 pnpm exec vitest run --config test/vitest/vitest.agents-embedded-agent.config.ts --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run.codex-app-server-recovery.test.ts`
  - Failed: `does not deliver assistant output from non-completion Codex turn watch timeouts` received the assistant text as a successful payload.
- GREEN after the non-completion guard:
  - same embedded-runner command: `1 passed`, `12 passed`.
- RED for the ClawSweeper active-item review on PR head `c53227734a6337507d4f538e049a7523e04e2ebf`:
  - same embedded-runner command after adding `does not deliver assistant output while Codex item lifecycle is active`
  - Failed: expected the missing-completion error, but received `This active-item answer must stay withheld.` as a successful payload.
- GREEN after the active-item guard:
  - same embedded-runner command: `1 passed`, `13 passed`.
- RED for the ClawSweeper terminal-state review on PR head `e82b799baf5a9d6360b269218c75c3f68dc7767a`:
  - same embedded-runner command after adding terminal-state cases.
  - Failed: terminal heartbeat responses, tool media, tool media block replies, and source reply payloads still received recovered assistant output.
- GREEN after the terminal-state guard and lint cleanup on current head `f17142b86912eb7cb8da5f6c172e813e35484783`:
  - same embedded-runner command: `1 passed`, `21 passed`.
  - App-server event-stream proof: `node scripts/test-projects.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/run-attempt.turn-watches.test.ts -- --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism --reporter=dot`: `1 passed`, `66 passed`.
  - Focused lint proof: `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run.codex-app-server-recovery.test.ts` passed.
  - Whitespace/docs check: `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD` passed.

Current-head behavior proof:

- Embedded runner delivery/fail-closed proof:
  - `OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 pnpm exec vitest run --config test/vitest/vitest.agents-embedded-agent.config.ts --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run.codex-app-server-recovery.test.ts`
  - Passed scenarios include:
    - `delivers safe assistant text after a missing turn/completed timeout`
    - `does not deliver assistant output from non-completion Codex turn watch timeouts`
    - `does not deliver assistant output while Codex item lifecycle is active`
    - `does not recover assistant output over terminal heartbeat responses`
    - `does not recover assistant output over terminal tool media`
    - `does not recover assistant output over terminal source reply payloads`
    - `does not hand Codex app-server idle timeouts to model fallback`
    - `does not retry after visible assistant output`
  - Result: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 21 passed (21)`.
- Codex app-server turn-watch boundary proof:
  - `node scripts/test-projects.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/run-attempt.turn-watches.test.ts -- --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism --reporter=dot`
  - Passed scenarios include:
    - `marks Codex completion-idle timeouts after completed items as replay-invalid`
    - `does not use completion timeout outcome for terminal timeout with active mutating item`
    - `does not use completion timeout outcome for non-completion timeout with assistant output`
    - `releases the session after a raw assistant response item without turn completion`
    - `delivers completed assistant output when the client closes before turn completion`
    - `keeps partial assistant output as a client-close failure`
  - Result: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 66 passed (66)`.

Mantis proof-lane note:

- Run [28619264000](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28619264000) failed because the native Telegram Desktop proof lane could not synthesize the required Codex app-server missing `turn/completed` condition. The Mantis agent wrote a capture-failure manifest instead of fabricating visual evidence.
- That failure is treated as a proof-harness mismatch, not as evidence that the recovery predicate or app-server runner tests failed. The proof boundary for this PR is OpenClaw runner/app-server recovery behavior under deterministic app-server event streams.

## Proof Boundary

This proves OpenClaw recovery/delivery behavior for the missing `turn/completed` completion-timeout mitigation. It does not claim the upstream Codex app-server root cause is fixed.
